items.name: DecompressionMatcher
items.summary: A matcher for determining how to decompress files.

methods.name: command
methods.signature: fn command<P: AsRef<Path>>(&self, path: P) -> Option<Command>
methods.summary: Return a pre-built command based on the given file path that can decompress its contents. If no such decompressor is known, then this returns `None`.

methods.name: has_command
methods.signature: fn has_command<P: AsRef<Path>>(&self, path: P) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if the given file path has at least one matching command to perform decompression on.

methods.name: defaults
methods.signature: fn defaults(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut DecompressionMatcherBuilder

items.name: DecompressionReader
items.summary: A streaming reader for decompressing the contents of a file.

methods.name: close
methods.summary: Closes this reader, freeing any resources used by its underlying child process, if one was used. If the child process exits with a nonzero exit code, the returned Err value will include its stderr.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new<P: AsRef<Path>>(path: P) -> Result<DecompressionReader, CommandError>
methods.summary: Build a new streaming reader for decompressing data.

items.name: DecompressionReaderBuilder
items.summary: Configures and builds a streaming reader for decompressing data.

methods.name: async_stderr
methods.signature: fn async_stderr(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut DecompressionReaderBuilder
methods.summary: When enabled, the reader will asynchronously read the contents of the command's stderr output. When disabled, stderr is only read after the stdout stream has been exhausted (or if the process quits with an error code).
